observations: Photo 0: Front view of an Apple iMac with a silver base and black bezel, displaying a macOS desktop with a coastal island wallpaper. The Apple logo is visible on the front bezel. A small white sticker is on the top left corner of the screen.
Photo 1: Side view of the same iMac, showing its thin profile and stand. The background includes shelves with boxed items and a door. The iMac is on a white counter with a gold 'GEEK' logo.

Photo 2: Screenshot of the macOS 'About This Mac' window showing: macOS Catalina 10.15.7, iMac (21.5-inch, Late 2012), 2.7 GHz Quad-Core Intel Core i5, 8 GB 1600 MHz DDR3, NVIDIA GeForce GT 640M 512 MB, Serial Number DGKK803BDCNR.

claims.claim: Uk used Late 2012/2013 iMac 21.5inches Retina Display
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows 'iMac (21.5-inch, Late 2012)' and no Retina Display. The Late 2012 iMac did not have a Retina display; Retina was introduced in 2014. The 'UK used' claim is unverifiable_remote.
Photo 2 shows '2.7 GHz Quad-Core Intel Core i5'.
Photo 2 shows '8 GB 1600 MHz DDR3', not DDR4. DDR4 was not available in this model.
Photo 2 does not show storage capacity. The 'About This Mac' window only shows memory and graphics. Storage is not visible.

risks.risk: The iMac may have a damaged or non-functional display, or screen issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the screen from multiple angles, including brightness, color, and any dead pixels or flickering.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential screen defects

risks.risk: The 1TB storage claim is unverified; the actual storage may be less or not present.
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot showing the 'Storage' tab in 'About This Mac' with the actual drive capacity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown or less than claimed storage

risks.risk: The iMac may have hardware issues (e.g., fan noise, overheating, keyboard/mouse not included) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video showing the iMac in operation, including boot-up, fan noise, and any physical damage or missing parts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially having hidden hardware issues

proof_requests: Screenshot or photo of the 'Storage' tab in 'About This Mac' to verify the 1TB claim.
Video showing the iMac in operation, including boot-up, fan noise, and screen performance from multiple angles.
Photo of the back of the iMac showing ports and any physical damage.
response.reason: The model and processor are confirmed, but the seller's claims about Retina display and DDR4 RAM are contradicted by the photos. The 1TB storage claim is unverified. Hidden risks include screen defects and unknown hardware issues. Proof is needed to verify storage and assess condition before pricing.
